params.caption: 🎮 KFC stages a fake funeral so fans can skip work for GTA 6 KFC in Australia is holding a mock funeral for a woman named "Ann Alibi", giving players a "legitimate" excuse to take the day off and play Rockstar's new game. The service, with a hearse, coffin and flowers, takes place Thursday, November 19 at 11 AM at KFC Robina in Queensland, and can be attended in person or watched by livestream. KFC pitches the Gold Coast as Australia's answer to GTA 6's Vice City. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 16:42 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 😂 Genius or too much? React 👍 or 👎 and tell us how you're taking the day off 💬 #GTA6 #KFC #RockstarGames #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
